text:
alia-peopleops: Quick Q — team going through a merger next week. We have 2 managers (Sreena + Mohit) submitting level changes for 4 ICs. What is the latest payroll cutoff we can hit for a July 1 effective date?

sreena-manager: Trying to understand the approvals flow too — do we need 2 separate manager approvals for merged headcount or one combined packet?

mohit-eng: Also the comp amount for one hire has an earnout component tied to performance ops — does that need separate sign-off from legal?

devon-hr: Hi! Payroll cutoff for July 1 is Tue Jun 25 EOD for comp changes that require compensation committee review. If everything is manager-approved + people ops reviewed and legal/comp sign-off done by then, payroll can process July 1.

alia-peopleops: Thanks — is there a checklist we should follow? Can we attach the merged-team packet to the same case?

jenn a-payroll: @alia-peopleops please note: payroll needs final approved amount in the canonical CSV (template link below) and the signed manager approvals as PDFs by cutoff. One packet per person, but you can link them in one case.

alia-peopleops: link: https://redwood.infra/people-ops/comp-change-template.csv

payroll-bot: Submission received: case #5423 uploaded by alia-peopleops. Status: pending -> people ops review. ETA: 48h. :white_check_mark:

mohit-eng: For the earnout: legal sign-off is required if >15% variable pay or if the earnout is >12 months, per policy. @devon-hr can you confirm?

devon-hr: Correct — long earnouts need legal + compensation committee if >$10k expected payout. Please include the earnout schedule in the packet (CSV column: earnout_schedule).

alia-peopleops: Quick checklist I'm hearing: 1) Manager approval(s) PDFs, 2) canonical CSV with final amounts, 3) earnout schedule if applicable, 4) legal sign-off when policy thresholds hit, 5) submit by Jun 25 EOD. Anything missing?

jenn a-payroll: Add: employee consent form for equity changes (if equity is part of comp change). Also make sure manager approvals include manager email + manager title.

sreena-manager: If approvals are delayed how late can we do a retro adjustment? (what's the window and paperwork?)

devon-hr: Retro is allowed up to 3 pay cycles back for genuine processing delays; requires manager explanation + people ops sign-off + payroll adjustment form (see: https://redwood.infra/people-ops/retro-adjust-form). Anything older than that needs exec approval and payroll/legal sign-off.

alia-peopleops: Noted. For merged teams, we'll create separate per-employee packets and reference them under one case. We'll tag as "merger-bridge" and message payroll if we hit any blockers.

mohit-eng: Thanks all — I'll coordinate with Sreena tonight to get manager PDFs.

alia-peopleops: I'll start the case and upload preliminary CSV by EOD tomorrow. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. :pray:

payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll office hours today 3pm PT for last-minute questions — join: https://meet.redwood/payroll-office-hours

sreena-manager: joining 3pm.

alia-peopleops: Closing note — tagging for visibility: @jenna-payroll @devon-hr @mohit-eng @sreena-manager.
